title: Compact heat working interface and workspace navigation
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open saved interface
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved working-interface link for the proof run.

manualSteps.label: Desktop preference
manualSteps.instruction: At desktop width, open Workspace Files.

manualSteps.label: Compact navigation
manualSteps.instruction: Resize to480px. Open Files, then close with Escape, Close or clicking the shaded space to the right of Files.

manualSteps.label: Restore
manualSteps.instruction: Resize back to1440px and check the file panel returns.

manualSteps.label: Editor
manualSteps.instruction: At compact width click Open workflow and inspect Diagram and Source.

steps.label: Updated installed workspace
steps.summary: The updated package opens through the normal workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify the owning workspace, not a detached UI route.
steps.actual: Normal Workflows and Files controls are available.

steps.label: Saved engineering interface and desktop navigation
steps.summary: The same exact results render with the desktop file panel open.
steps.purpose: Establish saved identity and desktop preference before compact resizing.
steps.action: Open the saved working link; click Workspace Files if closed.
steps.expected: Exact recorded results and docked navigation.
steps.actual: 18 exact result identities; docked file panel 260px wide.

steps.label: Compact content gets the workspace width
steps.summary: The file panel no longer consumes the compact document width.
steps.purpose: Check actual document/iframe width and retained engineering results.
steps.expected: Navigation closed; document wider than420px; same live frame/results.
steps.actual: Document 432px; embedded body 382px with 533px scroll width and visible horizontal overflow; same iframe and results.

steps.label: Files remains accessible as compact navigation
steps.summary: Files opens over the working view without resizing or restarting it.
steps.purpose: Keep normal file navigation available at compact widths.
steps.expected: Focused close control and overlay navigation; document width unchanged.
steps.actual: Compact overlay opens; Close is focused; the same iframe keeps its available width.

steps.label: Compact return and keyboard focus
steps.summary: Escape, Close and clicking back to the workspace all dismiss navigation.
steps.purpose: Verify return controls and preservation of the desktop preference.
steps.action: Press Escape; reopen Files and click Return to workspace; reopen and click Close.
steps.expected: Navigation closes; Escape returns focus; desktop preference remains expanded.
steps.actual: All three return paths work; Escape restores Files focus; desktop preference and exact results are preserved.

steps.label: Small phone and wider compact workspace
steps.summary: The working view remains available at360px and640px.
steps.purpose: Check container-driven compact layout on both sides of480px.
steps.expected: Available document width and same exact results.
steps.actual: Both compact sizes use the available width with navigation closed; result identities remain exact.

steps.label: Entry stopped
steps.summary: The normal workspace entry did not meet the expected state.
steps.action: Stop at the unexpected entry state.
